summary: Frontend-only real-browser verification of AUTH-01 (no spurious logout with valid cookie) and AUTH-02 (recoverable /auth/me error screen + retry). All 3 requested behaviors PASS. Backend not tested (per request); email login form not submitted (captcha-gated).
test_results: PASS - Happy path/AUTH-01: cookie session_token=audit_bounce_test_sess injected before goto /admin -> single /api/auth/me 200, URL stays /admin (also after 10s wait and after reload), admin UI rendered (admin-nav-overview, admin-overview-hub, admin-logout etc.), no email-auth-dialog, no auth-check-error, no redirect to '/'. Note: [data-testid=admin-tab-deliveries] only exists in the Deliveries sub-view (AdminDeliveries.jsx), not on the /admin overview; used admin-nav-* as the marker instead.

PASS - AUTH-02: route '**/api/auth/me' fulfilled 503 (no cookie) -> [data-testid=auth-check-error] shown with text 'No se pudo verificar tu sesión', [data-testid=auth-check-retry-btn] visible, URL stays /admin, no admin UI rendered (admin-tab/nav count 0).
PASS - AUTH-02 retry: unroute then click retry -> /api/auth/me returned 401 -> app navigated to '/' (landing), error screen gone.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: checkAuth (used as retry) does not set status to CHECKING or disable the retry button while the request is in flight, so double-clicks fire multiple /auth/me calls and the user gets no feedback. The auth generation guard keeps this safe, but a loading state on the retry button would be better.
Review request marker admin-tab-deliveries is not on the default /admin view; future tests should use admin-nav-overview or admin-overview-hub.
seed_data_creation: None; seeded cookie audit_bounce_test_sess was still valid (curl /api/auth/me -> 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AUTH-01/02 browser integration verified via cookie injection plus page.route on **/api/auth/me (503). Use admin-nav-overview as the admin panel marker. AUTH-03 is covered only by Jest unit tests (captcha blocks real email login).
